notes: Strip is mostly estates (E.M. Pattison, German Catholic Cemetery Ass'n, Allen estate, A.L. Foster). West 8th Street runs along the top edge (centre about y 150) with no street meeting it inside x 4540-6540 on the plate; two margin tabs above it at x ~5400 ('TO...') and x ~5900 ('RBA...', with a vertical line crossing 8th to y ~170) are cut off and show no street edges, so not picked. Delhi is printed only as 'DELHI' (no suffix). The large spaced letters across lots 27-33/56-63 near x 6000-6200, y 5700-6300 are subdivision lettering, not a street. Lots along the east edge (x 6100-6540, y 2400-5000) front streets east of x 6540; none inside the window.
